title: DMZ mine short
hook: Korean War 2?! North Korea planted mines in the DMZ

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: South Korean soldiers were searching inside the *DMZ*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Three officers were wounded. One battalion commander *lost a foot*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The worst mine injury on the border in *eleven years*.

items.text: Probe: mines planted by N. Korea

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: A joint investigation with the U.N. Command found the mines were *planted by North Korea*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: A third, unexploded mine was found nearby.

scenes.name: Kim Yo Jong
scenes.quote: A spectacle too good to watch alone.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Pyongyang denies it. Kim Yo Jong *mocked* Seoul, calling the debate a spectacle too good to watch alone.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In Seoul, the Unification Minister called it *a regrettable accident*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon shot back: how is burying mines on our side an *accident*?

scenes.name: Cha Ji-hoon
scenes.role: South Korea's Ambassador to the U.N.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Now Seoul is demanding an *apology* at the United Nations.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: North Korea's reply? It will defend its territory with *strength, not negotiations*.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: How close is the peninsula to the edge? Watch the *full story* on our channel.
